page: Microsoft Azure E4ads_v5 is a memory-optimized virtual machine instance powered by the AMD EPYC 7763 processor running on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. The instance features 4 dedicated virtual CPUs derived from 2 physical cores with multithreading enabled, reaching clock speeds up to 3.7 GHz. Cache architecture includes 32 KB of L1 data cache, 1.0 MB of L2 cache, and 32 MB of shared L3 cache. Instruction set extensions include AVX, AES, VAES, and SHA-NI, while AVX-512 and AMX extensions are absent.

Resource allocation is balanced toward high-memory capacity, providing 32.0 GB of RAM, or 8.0 GB per vCPU. The instance is bundled with 161 GB of local SSD temporary storage and supports premium storage attachments. There are no discrete GPUs included, and no complimentary public IPv4 addresses are assigned by default.

Performance profiles exhibit strong single-core compute results, landing in the top quartile in stress-ng single-core tests and average single-thread decompression and Geekbench scores. However, aggregate multi-core and throughput metrics reflect the low physical core count, placing multi-core stress-ng, Geekbench compilation, ray tracing, and static web serving in the bottom quartile. Memory bandwidth benchmarks measured 37.42 GB/sec for uncached reads and 22.82 GB/sec for writes, both falling into lower percentiles.

From an efficiency perspective, the high RAM allocation relative to vCPU count makes this profile suitable for memory-sensitive tasks without paying for unnecessary compute capacity. Workloads well aligned with this hardware profile include in-memory caching layers, medium-scale relational databases, enterprise software components, and lightweight backend services requiring a large working set and fast local temporary storage.
description: Microsoft Azure E4ads_v5 is a memory-optimized virtual machine configured with 4 dedicated vCPUs from 2 physical AMD EPYC 7763 cores operating up to 3.7 GHz on Microsoft Hyper-V. It provides 32.0 GB of system memory, establishing an 8:1 memory-to-vCPU ratio, and includes 161 GB of local SSD storage without bundled GPUs. Benchmark outcomes reveal strong single-thread compute capabilities alongside moderate memory throughput, with multi-core throughput scaling constrained by the two physical core layout. Hardware cryptographic acceleration is present via AES and SHA-NI instruction sets, though AVX-512 extensions are not supported. Given the generous memory allocation per core and fast local scratch disk, the E4ads_v5 is suited for relational database instances, memory-intensive backend services, in-memory caching nodes, and data processing tasks requiring substantial working memory relative to compute needs.
